vocabulary.definition: limiting or controlling someone or something
vocabulary.example: The company imposed restrictive measures on its employees to improve productivity.

vocabulary.definition: a formal agreement or contract between two parties
vocabulary.example: The landlord and the tenant signed a covenant outlining the terms of the lease.

vocabulary.definition: of the same or a similar kind or nature
vocabulary.example: The school aimed to create a homogeneous student body by accepting students from diverse backgrounds.

vocabulary.definition: a dead-end street or a street closed at one end
vocabulary.example: Their house was located at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, away from the main road.

vocabulary.definition: in a way that is too large or too small in comparison with something else
vocabulary.example: The new policy disproportionately affected low-income families.

vocabulary.definition: the process of renovating and improving a neighborhood, often leading to the displacement of long-time residents
vocabulary.example: The neighborhood underwent gentrification, causing rent prices to skyrocket and forcing many residents to move.
